limitations: Post-GC same-scene menu samples indicate retained browser heap; object counters do not measure GPU VRAM.
Frame intervals include browser scheduling, GPU backpressure and the small measurement wrappers; these are not isolated interactive FPS measurements.
LongTask overlap and CPU/GPU frame IDs are correlation only: queued GPU work can delay later callbacks.
The final continuous RAF task may finish after the observer is disconnected; its raw CPU time remains captured, but its LongTask notification is not guaranteed.
GPU windows instrument CPU/work counters and are separate from the continuous memory windows; do not compare them as an A/B speedup.
The last work bucket contains submissions outside the main composer, including any cloud preparation/endpoint work; per-pass queries cover the main composer only.
Native AMD/D3D11,1280x720,DPR1; no other GPU,4K,DPR2,multi-hour or SwiftShader portability claim.
Retainer sampling is a separate short follow-up; shallow heap growth and selected paths are not a dominator analysis or a decomposition of the long-run delta.
Two raw heap snapshots remain local with archived hashes; their independent recomputation requires those files.
